description.value: Rustic Bread Bakery is a bakery operated by Urban Deli Inc, located in a unit at 7487 Edmonds Street. As a neighbourhood bakery it would offer freshly baked breads and likely pastries to locals and passing cyclists. Its strip-mall unit format is typical of community bakeries in the greater Vancouver area.
